name: a check script exists under scripts/hygiene/
each hygiene script has a sibling test
argv: for f in $(ls scripts/hygiene/*.ts | grep -v '[.]test[.]ts$'); do test -f "${f%.ts}.test.ts" || exit 1; done

name: npm run check runs the hygiene script
argv: n=$(node -e "const s = require('./package.json').scripts; const n = Object.keys(s).find((k) => String(s[k]).includes('scripts/hygiene/')); if (!n) process.exit(1); process.stdout.write(n);") || exit 1; node -e "const s = require('./package.json').scripts; process.exit(String(s.check) + String(s['check:base'])).includes('run ' + process.argv[1]) ? 0 : 1)" "$n"

name: it refuses the planted conflict with exit 1
argv: n=$(node -e "const s = require('./package.json').scripts; const n = Object.keys(s).find((k) => String(s[k]).includes('scripts/hygiene/')); if (!n) process.exit(1); process.stdout.write(n);") || exit 9; npm run --silent "$n" >/dev/null 2>&1

name: it passes once the conflict is resolved
argv: n=$(node -e "const s = require('./package.json').scripts; const n = Object.keys(s).find((k) => String(s[k]).includes('scripts/hygiene/')); if (!n) process.exit(1); process.stdout.write(n);") || exit 9; cp docs/notes.md .git/notes.bak && printf '# Notes\nnew text\n' > docs/notes.md && npm run --silent "$n" >/dev/null 2>&1; s=$?; cp .git/notes.bak docs/notes.md; exit $s
